summary.text: Jason Luck is a Democratic member of the South Carolina House of Representatives, representing District 54, who assumed office on November 11, 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Luck advanced from the June 9, 2026 Democratic primary for District 54.
Ballotpedia lists him on the Invitations and Memorial Resolutions Committee and the House Judiciary Committee for the 2025-2026 session.
